## Keep or rush

In class order. Planned total about N of the 80 minutes.

| Item | Min | | If short |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Discussion 1: ... | 0 | Keep | The one thing to say |
| Problem 1: ... | 0 | Rush; cut first | The one-line fallback |
| Coding A: ... | 0 | Rush | |

: {tbl-colwidths="[32,6,16,46]"}

Minimum class, about N minutes: the items to protect. With more time, add ... back first.

## If you read on

How it runs

- Three lines at most: what students prepared and brought, the link to the complete class sheet (`https://ethics4ds.com/teachers/wkNN/class_complete.html`), what is outside the class.

What students should see

- The numbers.

Where they get stuck

- Five bullets at most.
